prohibitions: Do not read or commit .env values.
Do not invent About sections or lore.
Do not hard-code chat, channel, support or payment destinations.
Do not permit HTTP, Telegram usernames or arbitrary text as URL fallbacks unless separately evidenced and authorized.
Do not add Telegram/runtime wiring or production persistence in Stage 21.14.5c.
Do not manipulate game.db-wal or game.db-shm.

resolutions.contract: About content is canonical source-owned structured content. V2 must preserve confirmed section identity, ordering, titles and bodies without inventing or rewriting lore.
GAME_CHAT_URL, NEWS_CHANNEL_URL and SUPPORT_URL remain optional configuration keys. Runtime values are external configuration and must not be copied from .env into source, reports or defaults.
Configured public link buttons use fail-closed HTTPS validation. Missing, blank, malformed or non-HTTPS values are treated as unavailable rather than rendered.
Useful-links navigation exposes only individually configured valid links. One unavailable link does not authorize a placeholder, guessed URL or fallback transport.
Support is an optional validated external URL button. Provider name, destination and payment details are configuration data, not domain defaults; no payment flow or ledger mutation is added.
About and useful-links screens return to the canonical account menu. Callback and row layout must be copied only from confirmed V1 presentation evidence during adapter integration.
Stage 21.14.5c may implement API-ready content/configuration/validation models only. Telegram handlers, environment loading, runtime registration and production persistence remain disconnected.
